newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan ministry to help set up two biotech funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan ministry to help set up two biotech funds.

text.p: Taiwan's economics ministry said on Monday it was helping local companies set up two venture capital funds each with US$100 million to help develop the island's biotechnology industry.
"The two funds will be used to acquire foreign advanced biotechnology or shares of foreign biotechnology companies," an official at the ministry's Industrial Development Bureau told Reuters.
Six unidentified local companies have decided to invest in the first fund, which was expected to start operations soon, the official said.
The six local firms will jointly take 75 percent of the first fund, with the remainder invested by foreign partners, she said.
The second fund was slated to start fund-raising presentation in March or April, the official said.
The government plans to take part in the two funds through investment by state-run companies, she said.
